cases.name: Verify Link input format validation
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Socials
cases.condition: Merchant has entered Add new link or Edit link window

steps.desc: 1. Select protocol = https, enter invalid URL (e.g., abc), click Save
steps.result: 1. System blocks saving and shows “Please enter a valid URL”

steps.desc: 2. Select protocol = mailto, enter invalid email (e.g., abc@), click Save
steps.result: 2. System blocks saving and shows “Please enter a valid email”

steps.desc: 3. Select protocol = tel, enter invalid number (e.g., 12a34), click Save
steps.result: 3. System blocks saving and shows “Please enter a valid number”

steps.desc: 4. Select protocol = sms, enter invalid number, click Save
steps.result: 4. System blocks saving and shows “Please enter a valid number”

cases.name: Verify the special characters supported by Socia
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Socials

steps.desc: Enter special characters and Spaces in Socia and click "Save"
steps.result: Socia's format does not allow special characters and Spaces (except @,.-), otherwise it will prompt "Enter a valid username"

cases.name: Verify click behavior of Links with different protocols
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Socials
cases.condition: Merchant has configured and saved Links with https, mailto, tel, and sms protocols via Add new link window

steps.desc: 1. As a guest, visit the shop page
steps.result: 1. Successfully accessed the shop page

steps.desc: 2. Click the Link configured with https
steps.result: 2. Browser opens a new tab and navigates to the configured URL

steps.desc: 3. Click the Link configured with mailto
steps.result: 3. Default email client opens with recipient set to the configured email

steps.desc: 4. On mobile, click the Link configured with tel
steps.result: 4. Phone dialer opens with the configured number

steps.desc: 5. On mobile, click the Link configured with sms
steps.result: 5. SMS app opens with the recipient number set to the configured number

steps.desc: 6. The guest clicked on the link to invoke a third-party application, and then clicked "Cancel".
steps.result: 6. Normal display of the shop page

cases.name: Verify that Curator removes all Social links and then checks the shop icon
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Socials

steps.desc:
1.Curator enters My shop 

2. Click the Customize button, and choice Social

3. Clear the contents of all third-party platforms and mailboxes
steps.result: Curator successfully cleared all external links, and the platform icons on the shop page disappeared.

cases.name: Verify protocol selection and saving in Add new link window
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Socials
cases.condition: Merchant has entered My Shop → Links → Add new link window

steps.desc: 1. Click the protocol dropdown next to the Link input field
steps.result: 1. Dropdown correctly shows the selected protocol

steps.desc: 2. Select one of https / mailto / tel / sms
steps.result: 2. Input value combined with protocol is saved successfully

steps.desc: 3. Enter a valid URL, email, or number in the input field
steps.result: 3. Input value is accepted without error

steps.desc: 4. Click Save
steps.result: 4. System saves successfully and returns to Links list, new Link shows protocol + address correctly

cases.name: Verify that the Curator adds all external links and changes the location of the first and second links, then shares the contents of the successfully opened icon with the Consumer
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Socials

steps.desc:
#1 Curator into My shop

2. Click the Socials button under the store link

3. Enter the correct content for all third-party platforms and mailboxes, then drag and drop the header of the first link to swap places with the second link

4. Click the Save button

5. Share store links with consumers

6.Consumer enters Curator's shop and clicks on these ICONS
steps.result:
# The platform icon becomes black activated, the Curator successfully added all external links and changed the location of the first and second links; Consumer successfully opened links to these platforms in Curator's shop
ps: Social link supports all special characters

cases.name: Verify that Curator edits all Social links and changes the location of the links, and then checks the location of the shop icon
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Socials

steps.desc: 1.Curator enters My shop and click the "Customize".
steps.result: Curator successfully updated all external links and changed the position of the second and third platform icons on the shop page

steps.desc: 2. Click “Social” and edit all third-party platforms and email addresses to enter new content, then drag the header of the second link to swap positions with the third link
3 .Click the Save button

cases.name: Verify that Socia can display up to 7 on the shop page at most
cases.module: My Shop / Storefront / Edit Profile / Socials

steps.desc: Curator enters My shop, Click the Customize button, and choice Social
steps.result: At this time, Socia link is empty

steps.desc: Fill in all the Socia links and then return to the shop page
steps.result: At this point, only the first 7 Socia ICONS are displayed on the shop page
